analysis: 3-D small-strain linear elasticity and initial-stress eigenbuckling
geometry: Input STEP unchanged: four shared-interface regions. Tensor-product mesh conforms to all region interfaces; common DOFs ensure full displacement and traction continuity.
formulation: K from isotropic linear elasticity. Reference stress sigma=C:sym(grad u). G_ab=int sigma_ij (dN_a/dx_i)(dN_b/dx_j) dV for each displacement component. Solve -G phi=mu K phi, lambda=1/mu. Report smallest positive lambda. Dead reference traction, no follower load stiffness or self-weight.
quantity_extraction: Four largest positive reciprocal buckling eigenvalues with sparse generalized symmetric ARPACK; smallest positive load factor reported. Mode normalization max absolute displacement component=1. No beam or shell reduction.

physical_groups.surface_100_plus_face_index: external faces from faces.json, including support/load faces; internal interfaces not boundary elements

field_schema.node_ids: 1-based scalar FE DOF number; identical to Gmsh node tags
field_schema.connectivity_hex27: (nelement,27), Gmsh type 12 node ordering; entries are node_ids
field_schema.stress_MPa: (nelement,27,3,3), reference Cauchy stress at Gauss points, no averaging
field_schema.nodal_residual_N: K u - f; reactions at constrained DOFs

assumptions: Exact axis-aligned geometry represented by conforming quadratic solid elements.
Conventional full 27-point hexahedral integration for stiffness and geometric stiffness.
Linearized initial-stress buckling, not nonlinear collapse.
